title: K1 MP Eco-Walk: passive MP toe joints, human-gait imitation and learned relaxation for energy-efficient humanoid walking (simulation)
description: MuJoCo simulation study on the ROBOTIS AI Sapiens K1 humanoid model: passive spring toe (MP) joints, imitation of human gait data and learned joint relaxation for energy-efficient walking (37 % lower estimated electrical cost of transport than the public walk_default policy under the reported simulation condition), extended to speed-command walking, turning, running and automatic walk-run switching. Simulation only; not tested on a real robot. Idea and direction: Takeyuki-K. Implementation generated with Claude (Anthropic) under the direction of Takeyuki-K. Project code is Apache-2.0; human-gait-derived reference trajectories are CC BY 4.0 (Marcos Duarte & Renato Naville Watanabe, BMC, doi:10.5281/zenodo.4599319); CMU motion-capture data from mocap.cs.cmu.edu (NSF EIA-0196217). See NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
